name: io.github.codegiveness/postgresql-sharp-mcp
title: postgresql-sharp-mcp
description: PostgreSQL MCP server in C#/.NET: live database discovery, schema inspection, bounded read-only-by-default SQL, query plans and health checks.

environmentVariables.name: POSTGRES_CONNECTION_STRING
environmentVariables.description: One Npgsql key=value connection string (not a postgres:// URL). Creates the `primary` profile and enables live database discovery. Set this or POSTGRES_TARGETS/POSTGRES_TARGETS_FILE, not both.

environmentVariables.name: POSTGRES_TARGETS
environmentVariables.description: JSON object mapping profile names to bootstrap Npgsql connection strings. Takes precedence over POSTGRES_TARGETS_FILE; cannot be combined with POSTGRES_CONNECTION_STRING.

environmentVariables.name: POSTGRES_TARGETS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to an owner-protected JSON profile file (same shape as POSTGRES_TARGETS). The file holds credentials; the path itself is not secret.

environmentVariables.name: POSTGRES_DATABASES
environmentVariables.description: Optional database lock: JSON array of unique physical database names the server may ever open.

environmentVariables.name: POSTGRES_DATABASE_LOCK_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Database lock mode: advisory (default; PostgreSQL grant findings are warnings) or strict (findings refuse startup). strict requires POSTGRES_DATABASES.

environmentVariables.name: POSTGRES_REQUIRE_DATABASE_LOCK
environmentVariables.description: true makes a missing POSTGRES_DATABASES a startup error.

environmentVariables.name: POSTGRES_ACCESS_MODE
environmentVariables.description: unrestricted (default when omitted) permits explicitly requested writes; restricted refuses writes.

environmentVariables.name: POSTGRES_QUERY_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Per-call timeout in seconds (1-600).

environmentVariables.name: POSTGRES_MAX_ROWS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum rows per result page (1-5000).

environmentVariables.name: POSTGRES_MAX_RESULT_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum bytes per result payload (4096-1048576).

environmentVariables.name: POSTGRES_MAX_CELL_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum characters per returned cell (1-16384).

environmentVariables.name: POSTGRES_POOL_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: Maximum physical connections per pool (1-32).

environmentVariables.name: POSTGRES_MAX_CONCURRENT_CALLS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum concurrent database operations per process (1-64).

environmentVariables.name: POSTGRES_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Diagnostic level written to stderr.
